title: A scan with color under control
description: The original and the processed version are both available for comparison at every step.

blocks.text: For an illustration or a note in color, an automatic black-and-white filter can remove an important part of the content.

quote.text: This was touted as one of the better scanning apps. Well, the scan itself comes out very well, as soon as I want to edit anything on a document, it turns black-and-white. I scanned a beautiful color copy of a document, but every time I go to edit it, it goes from the colors to just black-and-white

blocks.text: Keep the original, the processing that was chosen and the comparison, right up to the export. Don’t change the mode unnoticed during later edits.
Accurate color can’t be promised for every shooting condition; the result has to be checked on the material at hand.
